['Leoni AG '].company_description: Leoni AG, based in Nuremberg, Germany, is a cable and harnessing manufacturing firm with branches throughout the world. It is listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange and is a member of the mid-cap MDAX index, and is claimed as global leader of cable systems.

['Skoda Auto Deutschland GmbH '].company_description: Škoda Auto Deutschland GmbH is a Czech automobile manufacturer that is part of the Volkswagen Group. The company sells its automobiles in over 100 countries and has a wide range of products, including the Škoda Superb, a mid-size/large family car, and Škoda Transportation, which develops and manufactures electric rail vehicles for urban and railway transport.
